newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea seeks 20,000T of U.S. No. 1 soybean.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea seeks 20,000T of U.S. No. 1 soybean.

text.p: South Korea's state-run Agricultural & Fishery Marketing Corp (AFMC) said on Thursday it would invite tenders for 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 1 soybean for September 5.
An official at the corporation said it will close the bids by 3 p.m. (0600 GMT). The bids will be opened on September 6.
He said shipment was set for September 26-October 15 if from the U.S. Gulf or for October 11-30 if from the Pacific Northwest.
Arrival was set for the western port city of Inchon by November 20.
